g.text: From address to PCCC request (SLC 500, MicroLogix)
The address parts are reordered into the fields of a protected typed logical read (CMD 0x0F, FNC 0xA2).
bit 5 never goes on the wire:
read masks 0x0020 out of the word,
PLC-5 uses typed read FNC 0x68 instead. Its address is a list of levels (data table 0, file, element, sub-element)
and carries no file type, because the processor already knows the type of each file.
